name: Sakata 3D
summary: Spanish filament brand that retailers describe as 100% made in Spain, with one naming Polimersia Global S.L. as the manufacturer. Known for PLA 850 on NatureWorks Ingeo 3D850 resin, with silk, high-speed, matte, wood and Go&Print PLA lines plus PETG, ABS-E, ASA and HIPS.

oem_relationships.notes: Optimus Digital product text says Sakata PETG is 'made in Spain by Polimersia Global S.L.'. Single retailer source; Polimersia may be the brand owner itself rather than a contract extruder.

product_lines.name: HR-870
product_lines.notes: Name points to NatureWorks Ingeo 3D870, the annealable high-heat grade; resin grade not confirmed by the notes.

additional_notes: No official brand website found; sold through Spanish and EU retailers (coolmod.com, filament2print.com, optimusdigital.ro). No price evidence was read, so price_tier is omitted. Other Spanish brands in the catalog (gst3d, smart-materials-3d, winkle) were checked and no link was found. SpoolmanDB PR lists 11 products.

provenance.conflicts: Spanish origin is consistent across retailers, but the Polimersia Global S.L. name comes from one retailer, and whether it is the brand owner or a contract maker is unresolved. City unknown.
